from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hashlib, json, re, subprocess
root=Path.cwd()
freeze=json.loads((root/"reports/T0006/review-r1-freeze/audit.json").read_text())
for name in ("src/kmesh/logic/proof.py","tests/test_proof.py","reports/T0006/record_check.py","reports/T0006/provenance.md","reports/T0006/mutation_set_check.py","docs/decisions.md"):
    assert hashlib.sha256((root/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==freeze["input_sha256"][name],name
for name,digest in freeze["history_sha256"].items():
    assert hashlib.sha256((root/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==digest,name
checks=subprocess.run(["git","diff","--check"],capture_output=True,text=True)
print(checks.stdout, end="")
print(checks.stderr, end="")
assert checks.returncode==0
docs=("docs/handoffs/T0006-proof-verifier.md","README.md","docs/implementation_status.md","reports/T0006/review-r1/review.md")
links=0
for name in docs:
    path=root/name
    text=path.read_text()
    assert text.endswith("\n")
    assert all(line==line.rstrip() for line in text.splitlines()),name
    for target in re.findall(r"\]\(([^)]+)\)", text):
        if "://" in target or target.startswith("#"):
            continue
        assert (path.parent/target.split("#",1)[0]).exists(),(name,target)
        links+=1
for name in docs[:3]:
    assert "needs_changes" in (root/name).read_text(),name
runs={}
for label in ("freeze","full","probes"):
    directory=root/f"reports/T0006/review-r1-{label}"
    d=json.loads((directory/"record.json").read_text())
    assert d["exit_code"]==0 and d["before"]["source_sha256"]==d["after"]["source_sha256"],label
    for stream in ("stdout","stderr"):
        assert hashlib.sha256((directory/(stream+".txt")).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==d[stream+"_sha256"]
    runs[label]={"exit_code":d["exit_code"],"elapsed_s":d["elapsed_s"],"argv":d["argv"]}
artifact={
    "created_at_utc":datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    "result":"NEEDS_CHANGES","task_status":"needs_changes",
    "reviewer":"Codex + gpt-6-astra (xhigh)",
    "independent_static_reviewer":"/root/review_t0006_tests",
    "input_snapshot":"reports/T0006/review-r1-freeze/input-snapshot",
    "product_sha256":freeze["input_sha256"]["src/kmesh/logic/proof.py"],
    "test_sha256":freeze["input_sha256"]["tests/test_proof.py"],
    "product_defect_found":False,
    "checks":{"A1":"PASS implementation and independent boundaries","A2":"PASS reviewed semantics","A3":"PASS implementation; R2 test fixes required","A4":"PASS implementation; R3 persistent tests required","A5":"NEEDS_CHANGES R2/R3","A6":"PASS independent product isolation; NEEDS_CHANGES R1 submitted guard","A7":"NEEDS_CHANGES R4 documentation/provenance"},
    "findings":["R1 solver import guard ineffective","R2 wrong-path/count/renaming fixtures do not isolate target behavior","R3 limit priority and giant integer persistent coverage incomplete","R4 README default/test command and evidence claims inaccurate"],
    "verification_runs":runs,
    "full_regression":"422 passed in 4.00s; no skips/xfails",
    "independent_boundary_case_count":16,
    "pi_runs_verified":len(freeze["pi_records"]),
    "historical_files_preserved":len(freeze["history_sha256"]),
    "diff_check_exit":checks.returncode,
    "local_links_checked":links,
    "review_artifacts_sha256":{n:hashlib.sha256((root/n).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for n in (*docs,"reports/T0006/review-r1/probe.py")},
    "limits":["No accepted task conclusion or commit/push.","Current product has no discovered logic defect, not a proof over all possible inputs.","Missing original launch/probe evidence remains a historical limitation; Codex reruns are not Pi originals.","Pi must preserve proof.py and repair tests/documentation under R1-R4."]
}
(root/"reports/T0006/review-r1/final-audit.json").write_text(json.dumps(artifact,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n")
print("PASS: frozen code/tests/recorder, original evidence and unrelated decisions preserved")
print("PASS: historical files preserved =",len(freeze["history_sha256"]),"local links checked =",links)
print("FINAL: T0006 needs_changes; R1-R4 handed back, no product modification")
